description:
Use this when the user wants to find a video or clip in their RipClip account by a word in its name: "find my
        tournament stream", "which clip is called the giveaway". query: 1-512 characters, every word must match.
        Searches project names and Library clip titles and details (not the spoken words inside a video) and returns up
        to 20 matches with id, title and url; pass an id to fetch for its details.
        Not for: searching what is said in a video (find_moments), browsing everything (list_projects, list_clips,
        list_library) or searching the web. Free and read only.
name: search
title: Search RipClip
